public_rationale: The two factual statements are supported on the stated reading. Reporting puts AI-specific capacity at about 2GW, and Microsoft announced approximately 1GW of additions in each of its three latest reported quarters. However, Microsoft described total capacity additions. These records do not support an inference that Microsoft claimed to add 3GW of AI-specific capacity or that the figures contradict one another.
limitations: Support concerns the reported AI-specific estimate, not an audited inventory of every source of Microsoft's AI compute.
The quarter selection uses reported quarters rather than all completed quarters.
The implied inconsistency would not receive the same verdict.

our_interpretation: Assess the two factual statements separately: approximately 2GW of AI-specific capacity, and three quarterly announcements of approximately 1GW of capacity additions.
Read 'last three fiscal quarters' as the last three publicly reported quarters before publication: quarters ending December 2025, March 2026 and June 2026.

For the ongoing capacity stock, use July–September 2026, the latest completed quarter before publication. The combined target interval also includes the three historical quarters explicitly referenced.
The wording does not explicitly say the quarterly additions were entirely AI-specific. Supporting both figures does not establish that they conflict.
criteria.support_condition: Independent reporting places Microsoft's AI-specific capacity at approximately 2GW, and Microsoft's statements confirm approximately 1GW of total capacity additions in each of the three referenced reporting quarters.
criteria.contradiction_condition: Comparable reporting establishes a materially different AI-specific capacity stock, or Microsoft's statements do not substantiate the three approximately 1GW quarterly announcements.
